newsitem.title: PERU: Explosion heard near siege site in Peru - radio.
newsitem.headline: Explosion heard near siege site in Peru - radio.

text.p: A loud explosion was heard early on Tuesday near the site of the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima where Marxists guerrilla are holding 74 VIP hostages, Peru's national radio reported.

A Reuters photographer one block from the residence also said she heard an explosion, apparently coming from within the diplomatic compound. The explosion was immediately followed by silence and no movement was seen within the grounds of the residence.
The CPN local radio station reported that a person was seen in the garden area in front of the diplomatic mansion shortly before the explosion.
The report could not immediately be confirmed.
Police guarding the residence moved into a state of alert following the explosion but did not approach the building, witnesses said.
